title: Imagine the Future, Internalize the Gist: Efficient VLA Reasoning via Internalized Spatiotemporal Imagination
abstract: arXiv:2610.02626v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate intermediate reasoning to improve robotic manipulation, yet existing approaches primarily reason about observed states without explicitly anticipating future scene evolution. Extending such reasoning to explicit future rollouts at every inference step, however, introduces substantial computational overhead. We propose IG-VLA, a VLA reasoning framework that enables models to imagine the future and internalize the gist. Our Latent Spatiotemporal Reasoning learns to imagine task-relevant future scene evolution directly in visual representation space, guiding action prediction without costly pixel-level video generation. To further reduce inference overhead, we introduce Scene Gist Memory, which internalizes reasoning-derived scene-behavior associations into a compact Scene Gist Token, preserving the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing explicit future imagination at infe

translated_title: 想象未来，内化要旨：通过内化时空想象实现高效的VLA推理
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益融入中间推理以提升机器人操作能力，然而现有方法主要针对观测到的状态进行推理，并未显式地预测未来场景的演变。而若在每次推理步骤中都将推理扩展到显式的未来推演，则会引入大量计算开销。我们提出IG-VLA，一个使模型能够想象未来并内化其要旨的VLA推理框架。我们的潜在时空推理学会直接在视觉表征空间中想象与任务相关的未来场景演变，从而引导动作预测，而无需代价高昂的像素级视频生成。为进一步降低推理开销，我们引入了场景要旨记忆，它将推理所得的场景-行为关联内化为一个紧凑的场景要旨标记，在保留未来推理优势的同时，在推理阶段绕过显式的未来想象。
tldr: 提出IG-VLA框架，通过在视觉表征空间中直接想象任务相关的未来场景演变，并将其内化为紧凑的场景要旨标记，使VLA模型在推理时无需昂贵的显式未来推演即可获得未来推理带来的动作预测增益，实现高效的机器人操作。
en_tdlr: IG-VLA enables VLA models to imagine future scene evolution directly in latent visual space and internalize it into a compact Scene Gist Token, retaining the benefits of future reasoning while bypassing costly explicit future imagination at inference.
